answer: Sybil resistance works when every identity must post a refundable but slashable stake. An agent locks a deposit before it can earn rewards; if peers prove it lied, the deposit burns. Like an orchard where each tree needs its own plot of paid soil, every fake identity carries a real upfront price. A public beacon logs each slash, so history follows the stake. An attacker must fund a whole plume of fake agents and keep all of them honest forever; one exposed lie torches one deposit, so farming rewards through sybils costs more than it ever pays.
